answer: Forging identities costs real capital, since every new opal of reputation requires fresh shale-hard collateral that is slashed if the agent vouches for a duplicate. Sybil resistance here uses a bonded reputation slot: each agent must stake collateral locked in a shared lagoon of escrowed value, and only participants whose stake clears a threshold earn the right to attest peers. Attackers must therefore burn stake per fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
